Check checklist: card 01 text "确认5人同行..." slightly cramped near right edge? fits. Card 04 time text wraps. Right panel "待自行确认" fine. Card 02 "4.6 公里 | 3.2 公里" fine. Minor: 01 卡片正文尾行贴卡片右边（"推进。"换行紧贴），轻微。整体良好。

appendix: 顶部大标题下副标题 "按资料原文区分计划、未确定与已完成三类状态" 中"未确定"加粗深色与"计划"浅棕链接色，其余句子灰色较浅—副标题文字颜色偏浅（灰色、对比度略低）。整体良好，明确。

记录 visual for checklist & appendix，附 minor improvement 或者无问题。我给一个 improvement：appendix 副标题灰色浅色文字对比度略低。checklist：01卡片正文换行后行尾紧贴卡片右侧内边距（"推进。"），轻微拥挤。这两个都是 improvement，不阻断。

evidence_id: c4449e1bef2573d39b9763691f22bfd1db2c6b9a7e82008dd90e4fa5ab5b8005.

Then content assessment: need inspect content for all pages + global_summary true. I have content evidence for 6 pages? Yestwo batches: evidence 79966 and c4449e1. Content kinds were requested in both. Content assessment should cover all pages, referencing both evidence ids.

Content issues? Check required section names appear in page titles: 行程原则 (page 2 title visible "行程原则" yes), 第一天 (page 3 visible title "第一天"), 第二天 (page 4 "第二天"), 准备清单 (page 5). Good. Key data: 2天, 5人, 4.6, 3.2, 点位, 偏好, 不提供项. Present. 状态区分: 计划/未确定/已完成 in appendix; day1 has 已明确（计划）/未确定. No fabricated dates/budget. Good.

One potential content issue: cover says "日期：未确定（资料未提供具体日期）" — fine, not fabricating.

Potential issue: checklist page "每天 1 段机动" — "1段" is a quantification inferred, source says "保留机动时间". "每天1段" is slight invention of a number. That's minor improvement: 把"每天 1 段机动"改为不计数表述"每天预留机动时间"。Also "4 个停留点" count is derived from 4 place names — fine.

Also day2 "低于首日 4.6 公里，留出恢复空间" — "留出恢复空间" is an interpretation but stated in plan bullets; acceptable.

Also appendix "预算额度 未确定" — source says 不提供门票价格...预算 not mentioned; user constraint says 不编造预算. Listing 预算 as 未确定 is fine (not fabricating amount).

So content issue: checklist card 04 "每天 1 段机动" 中的数量"1 段"无资料依据 → improvement, page_ids checklist.

Let me first record visual for these 2 pages. Then content global.

I'll record visual now.
